labs/lab-code-indices.title: Select a row, a match and a source range
labs/lab-code-indices.description: The second displayed row is highlighted, the second amount match is marked, and a copy of the first amount moves above the source.
walkthrough: startLineNumber is 40, so the three source rows are displayed as 40, 41 and 42. highlightLine(41) addresses the second row rather than source-array index 41.
highlightText counts nonoverlapping matches across all source rows. Its occurrence argument of 2 selects amount in the second row; the displayed line numbers do not affect this lookup.
extractTextByIndices uses displayed line 40 and the half-open source range [6, 12). removeOriginal defaults to false, so the source word stays in place.

The extracted group initially belongs to the code's scrollGroup. This scene detaches it and adds it as a scene root so it can move above the code window. That simple transfer preserves placement here because the Code has no transform and sits at origin; for a transformed parent, preserve the world transform when reparenting.
experiments: Change startLineNumber to 100 and the line arguments to 101 and 100. Keep occurrence at 2 and compare which annotations move.
Change endCol from 12 to 11 to leave out the final t, then pass true as the fourth extraction argument to hide the selected original glyphs.
